notes: Copilot self-reports task progress via irrlicht's OWN in-band hidden marker (irrlicht-eta), driven by a persistent instruction-file rule seeded as AGENTS.md in the run cwd — NO hook. SESSION MODEL: single-birth (Copilot mints $COPILOT_HOME/session-state/<session-id>/ at launch and the session id is that DIRECTORY, stable for the session's whole life — no presession reconcile, unlike codex/gemini-cli), so session_birth anchors to recording start UNPINNED and every later phase pins same_session_as session_birth. Turn boundaries are EXPLICIT (user.message -> working, assistant.turn_end -> ready), so the four ready->working->ready cycles below are read, not inferred. THE MARKER PATH: parseAssistantMessage (parser.go:189-208) calls tailer.ScanTaskEstimate over the FULL data.content before TruncateAssistantText narrows it, setting ev.TaskEstimate; copilot emits assistant.message SEVERAL times per turn and the parser scans each, so the latest valid marker wins. From there everything is shared: tailer carry-over across empty passes, metrics/adapter.go -> session.ForecastTaskCompletion -> task_completion_eta at the measured rate (elapsed/completed), and task_estimate {total_rounds, completed_rounds, updated_at} on SessionMetrics. AGENT SURFACE: instruction files are injected VERBATIM inside <custom_instruction> tags with renderMode:'raw' (app.js) — no markdown pass and no HTML sanitisation — so the fenced <!-- ... --> example survives, resolving the claudecode stripping trap in our favour. The PHASE DSL asserts only the user-observable lifecycle arc; the estimate-content invariants (completed_rounds present, non-decreasing, reaching total_rounds; updated_at advancing; ETA present once >=1 round is reported and burning down; fields present while working and suppressed by the CLIENT at ready) live in the scenario acceptance_criteria + the recipe verify[], mirroring how token-accounting's monotonic-token invariant lives outside the phase form. EMISSION IS THE RISK, not observation: this account routes to small models only (gpt-5-mini / claude-haiku-4.5; --model accepts only 'auto') and marker emission is model discretion even on frontier models. If record sees 0 or 1 markers the honest correction is agent=partial citing the recording — NOT daemon=bug. observations.model is deliberately NOT pinned (auto-routing can even switch mid-session); record fills it. BLOCKED ON TOOLING: this cell cannot record until the seed_instruction step type is ported into the copilot driver (same gap as codex/opencode/pi) — one primitive unblocks four cells.

text: The <session-id> session appears in ready — session.start is Skip=true, so a session coming into existence is not agent activity. Anchored UNPINNED to recording start so a transient proc-<PID> presession row cannot steal the birth.
First prompt (plan 4 phases, emit 0/4 then advance to 1/4) drives ready -> working; the first marker is emitted and task_estimate.total_rounds=4 appears on metrics
Turn 1 completes back to ready on assistant.turn_end; completed_rounds=1 (first reported round), so task_completion_eta is now projectable
Phase-2 prompt drives ready -> working on the same session; the marker advances toward 2/4 (completed_rounds non-decreasing, updated_at advances)
Turn 2 completes back to ready; the ETA projected after this marker is <= the ETA after turn 1 (burns down)
Phase-3 prompt drives ready -> working; the marker advances toward 3/4
Turn 3 completes back to ready; the ETA continues to burn down
Final phase-4 prompt drives ready -> working; the marker reaches 4/4 (completed_rounds == total_rounds by the final working turn)

Final turn completes working -> ready; final session state is ready. The 15s trailing idle captures the post-turn settle, after which the client suppresses the ETA chip (present only while working). The session never enters waiting — --allow-all pre-approves every tool, so no permission.requested is ever written.
